description: Land and Title Settlement Department -  Batakettara North, Kesbewa, Colombo District    - Cad. Map No.  521208
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including ownership details, property extents, encumbrances, and legal interests. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
